body.summary: A German Netflix series set in the small town of Winden, where the disappearance of two children exposes a time-travel conspiracy spanning generations. Four families (the Kahnwalds, Nielsens, Dopplers and Tiedemanns) are bound by an accident at the town's nuclear plant and by a cave system that lets people travel between 1953, 1986 and 2019, and later 1921 and 2052. The plot follows Jonas Kahnwald as he learns his own place in the loop, tries to prevent the deaths and disappearances, and discovers that many of the people he loves are the same person at different ages. The series ends with ||Jonas and Martha, having stepped outside the knot of two interlocking worlds, arriving in a third origin world where the time machine was never built and most of the cast never existed||.

arcs.summary: Children vanish near the caves, and the town's families discover the disappearances repeat across decades.
Jonas learns he is part of the loop and tries to break it, while factions in 1921 and the future pull him in different directions.
Two interlocking worlds are revealed, and Jonas and Martha seek the origin that created both.

notable_scenes.summary: Mikkel follows the others into the cave and emerges in 1986.
Old Helge is confronted in the bunker about the children.
Jonas meets his father as a boy and realises the family loop.
Adam reveals his face and his identity to Jonas.
The apocalypse at the plant destroys Winden.
Jonas and Martha step between worlds and reach the origin.
